howToPlay: Use the basic attack to poke enemies from a distance and control the field. Save the Super to pull isolated enemies toward you to eliminate them. Combine the gadgets and star powers to support your team or push back threats.
gears: Equip SPEED and HEALTH to increase mobility and survivability. Use TALK TO THE HAND or DAMAGE to improve Gene's offensive capabilities.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who excel at controlling the map and creating opportunities for their team.
